findings.observed: ObsUtils.normalize_obs accepts only inputs whose shape equals the statistics shape (1, D) or drops its leading dimension; SequenceDataset.get_item therefore fails for sequence items (seq_length 10: 'shape mismatch in @normalize obs' at dataset construction in cache mode all) and postprocess_batch_for_training fails for every BC-RNN batch (sizes 100, 2, 1) and any non-sequence batch larger than one
findings.consequence: hdf5_normalize_obs true cannot train the BC-RNN family on the pinned implementation; failure precedes the first optimizer update

findings.witness: statistics-reference-control-001.json: with seq_length 1 and batch size 1, where the shape checks pass, the dataset item equals a single normalization and the learner input after postprocess_batch_for_training equals a double normalization ((x-mean)/std normalized again) and not the single one
findings.consequence: even where finding-001 does not bite, the pinned training loop normalizes items in get_item and again in postprocess_batch_for_training because train.py passes the statistics to run_epoch; a corrected pilot must apply the transformation exactly once and prove it at batch level

findings.observed: a coordinate constant at 0.04 in float64 yields a float32 std of 0.001000013, not exactly the 1e-3 offset, because the float32 trajectory mean of identical values is not exact under pairwise summation; the reference emulation reproduces robomimic's statistics bit for bit on all keys and agrees with the exact float64 computation within 6.3e-7 relative on means and 1.3e-5 on that constant coordinate's std
